questions.stem: A 32-year-old primigravida presents to the obstetrics clinic at 32 weeks gestation with complaints of decreased fetal movements. The fundal height measurement is consistent with 28 weeks of gestation, and ultrasound confirms a diagnosis of IUGR. Which among the following is the false statement regarding Antenatal Doppler analysis?
questions.stemHtml: A 32-year-old primigravida presents to the obstetrics clinic at 32 weeks gestation with complaints of decreased fetal movements. The fundal height measurement is consistent with 28 weeks of gestation, and ultrasound confirms a diagnosis of IUGR. Which among the following is the false statement regarding Antenatal Doppler analysis?

options.label: A
options.text: Reduction in end diastolic flow is associated with poor outcome

options.label: B
options.text: Notching in uterine artery tracing can predict early-onset preeclampsia

options.label: C
options.text: MCA tracing is the most sensitive marker for IUGR

options.label: D
options.text: S/D ratio of umbilical artery is high in IUGR
